description: This file implements a COCO evaluator class for object detection, segmentation, and keypoints, supporting distributed processing. It includes methods for updating evaluation results, synchronizing across processes, and preparing results for COCO metrics, with custom evaluation logic adapted from pycocotools.

classes.name: CocoEvaluator
classes.description: Class for evaluating object detection, segmentation, and keypoints using COCO metrics, supporting distributed evaluation.

methods.name: convert_to_xywh
methods.description: Converts bounding boxes from (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) to (x, y, width, height) format.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges evaluation results from multiple processes.

methods.name: create_common_coco_eval
methods.description: Creates a combined COCO evaluation object from merged results.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Runs per-image evaluation and stores results, adapted from pycocotools with modifications.
